sanitize-ok: all seeded leak fixture
Seeded on purpose: the settings.json shape, where a Windows path is written with doubled
backslashes because the file is JSON. The escaping is the evasion the rule has to see through,
and a JSON string that itself carries JSON doubles them again.
{ "workdir": "C:\\Users\\realuser\\Repo\\example-app" }
{ "nested": "{ \\"workdir\\": \\"C:\\\\Users\\\\realuser\\\\Repo\\\\example-app\\" }" }
